.. change::
    :tags: sql, feature
    :tickets: 5564

    Added :meth:`_sql.CTE.limit` and :meth:`_sql.CTE.offset`, allowing limits
    and offsets to be applied to the complete SELECT or compound SELECT held
    by a CTE.  Recursive CTE identity is preserved when either method is
    chained after :meth:`_sql.CTE.union` or :meth:`_sql.CTE.union_all`.
